decisions.reason: The hyaluronic serum has stayed on the market through the 2024 portfolio cleanup that removed A and C, which suggests it meets the firm's aspiration level, so the satisficing choice is to keep it, with some risk from its low website prominence.

The cleansing oil was launched only in 2024, likely as the replacement for the withdrawn cleansing milk, so it has not yet had time to show a performance gap, and the small batch costs make it affordable to carry while results remain uncertain.
